full_track.tags: K-Pop ballad with jazz-pop influences. A clean electric guitar plays jazz-inflected chords with subtle chorus and reverb. A warm electric bass follows the vocal melody with melodic fills. The drums feature a soft snare with light ghost notes and a steady kick. A male tenor vocal delivers a conversational, rhythmic performance in Korean. The tempo is 84 BPM in the key of G Major. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the syncopated guitar strumming and the vocal phrasing.
